description: Find alternatives to an AI infrastructure product listed on Infrabase.ai. Products doing the same primary job rank first, then products sharing a secondary job, then the rest of its categories. Returns the anchor product, the alternatives in that order and the total count. Data is hand-verified. CC-BY-4.0. Each result includes an infrabase_url for attribution.

slug.description: Infrabase product slug as returned by search_tools, e.g. replicate. A product name or domain such as "Together AI" or "fal.ai" also works.
